goal: Give mining clients and the node visibility into memory held by active block templates
Track memory pinned by block templates after transactions are evicted from the mempool
Ensure safe template cleanup when external IPC mining clients disconnect during shutdown
agreement: Strong support for the tracking approach and shutdown fixes (ryanofsky, xyzconstant)
Tested on mainnet with a Stratum v2 template provider running for twenty hours (xyzconstant)
Verified locking, commit ordering, and interface tests (enochaz)
Open interface question on using a primitive versus a struct for the return value (ismaelsadeeq)

categories.name: ipc
why: P3 because it improves the mining IPC interface with memory reporting and safer shutdown cleanup
The IPC interface changes are useful but the main motivation is block template memory tracking

categories.name: mining
why: P2 because external Stratum v2 clients can hold templates indefinitely and pin evicted transactions
Provides visibility into pinned memory and lays groundwork to bound template memory usage
